editor.start.title: Task links for an agent
editor.start.intro: A run is driven by your AI agent — Claude Code, Codex or another. The browser only shows the progress: blocks light up, the «Timeline» grows. Copy the link you need and give it to the agent — it does the rest on its own.
editor.start.run_how: Paste the link into the terminal window where the agent works (Claude Code, Codex) or into its app chat. From the link the agent gets the leader task and instructions, starts a run of this folder and walks the scheme block by block, handing work to performers. You watch it here — on the canvas and in the «Timeline».
editor.start.draw_how: This link is for an agent that draws: it will create a scheme from scratch or fix this one. Give it the same way — into a terminal or an app — and then describe in words what you need: which scheme to draw or what to change in it.
